note: Authored fixtures with rubric-assigned tiers (1 weakest, 5 strongest), used to test whether the category weights rank resumes the way a reviewer does. This is a harness for the weights, not an empirical study: the tiers come from the rubric in docs/SCORING_METHODOLOGY.md, not from recruiter rankings.

rubric.5: Complete sections, every bullet quantified with scope, consistent dates, summary targeting a role.
rubric.4: Complete sections, most bullets quantified, minor formatting inconsistency.
rubric.3: All sections present, bullets describe activity rather than outcome, some dates missing.
rubric.2: Missing a major section, vague bullets, no quantification, inconsistent dates.
rubric.1: Sparse content, no summary, unreadable structure or almost no evidence.
